# sleep_sleeper (Resource)





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `apply_sleep` (Number) The number of seconds the provider should sleep before returning from Create. If not provided, it will use a random value between [0,N] where N is the maximum number of seconds configured at the provider level.
- `destroy_sleep` (Number) The number of seconds the provider should sleep before returning from Delete. If not provided, it will use a random value between [0,N] where N is the maximum number of seconds configured at the provider level.
- `plan_sleep` (Number) The number of seconds the provider should sleep before returning from ModifyPlan. If not provided, it will use a random value between [0,N] where N is the maximum number of seconds configured at the provider level.
- `read_sleep` (Number) The number of seconds the provider should sleep before returning from Read. If not provided, it will use a random value between [0,N] where N is the maximum number of seconds configured at the provider level.
- `string` (String) This is an attribute that can be configured to store the information in the state
- `string_wo` (String, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) This is an attribute that can be configured with ephemeral values. This value will be null in the returned state
- `string_wo_version` (Number, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Value associated with `string_wo`
- `update_sleep` (Number) The number of seconds the provider should sleep before returning from Update. If not provided, it will use a random value between [0,N] where N is the maximum number of seconds configured at the provider level.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The id of the resource. This will be generated on creation
